enonce_markdown: Which of the following is a social media platform?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Social media are websites and apps on which users create profiles, share content and interact with other people.

### Solution

Facebook lets users post photos, messages and videos and interact with friends, so it is a social media platform. Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet program, Google Chrome is a web browser and Adobe Reader displays PDF files. **Answer: b.**

enonce_markdown: State **two** disadvantages of students using social media during lesson time.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Think about what happens to concentration and to personal safety when students go online in class.

### Solution

Any two of:

- Students are distracted and pay less attention to the lesson.
- Time is wasted chatting instead of learning.
- Risk of cyberbullying or insulting messages.
- Students may meet inappropriate content or false information.

enonce_markdown: A Form 5 class in Douala creates a WhatsApp group for its subjects. What is the **main advantage** of the group for the students' school work?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

An advantage of a tool is a benefit it really brings to the task. Compare each option with what a group chat can truly do.

### Solution

A group chat lets the teacher share notes and assignments and answer questions quickly, even outside class hours. It does not remove the need for textbooks, it cannot guarantee that shared information is true, and it cannot filter inappropriate content on its own. **Answer: d.**

choix.texte: It removes the need for textbooks and exercise books.
It guarantees that all information shared in the group is correct.
It automatically blocks every inappropriate message.
It lets the teacher share notes and answer questions quickly outside class hours.

enonce_markdown: A student posts her full home address, her phone number and her daily timetable on a public social media profile. What is the **main risk**?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Personal information that is public can be read and used by anyone, including people with bad intentions.

### Solution

Strangers can use the information to find, harass or defraud her. The other options (more internet bundle used, account deleted, hard disk damaged) are not consequences of publishing personal details. **Answer: a.**

choix.texte: Strangers may use the information to trace, harass or defraud her.
Her internet bundle will be used up faster.
Her account will be deleted automatically.
The hard disk of her computer will be damaged.

enonce_markdown: A message saying "All schools will close on Monday" is being forwarded by many users on social media. What is the **best action** before sharing it?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Information on social media can be false and spread very quickly, so it should be verified before it is shared.

### Solution

The best action is to check the information from an official source, such as the school administration, the ministry or a trusted radio or TV announcement. Forwarding it immediately may spread false news; deleting an account or replying angrily does not check the facts. **Answer: c.**

choix.texte: Forward it quickly to all contacts so that nobody is late.
Check it from an official source such as the school administration.
Reply angrily to the person who sent it.

enonce_markdown:
A secondary school in Bamenda creates a Facebook page to announce its events.

(a) Give **two** benefits of the page for the school. (2 marks)

(b) A student posts an insulting comment about a teacher on the page. Name this kind of misuse of social media and state **two** measures the school can take. (3 marks)
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Link each benefit to communication with parents and students, and each measure to prevention (rules, moderation) or reaction (removal, discipline).

### Solution

**(a)** Any two: parents and students receive announcements immediately; the school can promote its activities and results; photos and videos of events are shared cheaply; messages reach many people at the same time.

**(b)** The misuse is **cyberbullying** (online harassment or insulting). Any two measures: delete the comment and block or report the user; moderate comments before they appear; apply the school discipline rules to the student; teach students good online behaviour (netiquette).
